# Network 360 Release

August 19, 2025

The production release took place after 4:00 p.m. CDT, 8/19/2025. 

# Network360 Core Team

This Network360 release includes a major enhancement for Model Networks.  Now, users can upload a list of providers and zip codes to create a model network! This new functionality can also be accessed through the Adequacy feature.  The release also includes other enhancements in Create a List and the Concise Office Export as well as fixes regarding security, global imports, Competitive Dashboard, user profiles, and the creation of new users.

# Enhancements

### Model Networks

##### *Import Network Functionality within Model Networks*

* Now users can import a list of provider’s NPIs and zip codes to create a model network.  Once this model network is published it can be used in other Network360 features to evaluate the network.  
* To access this feature within Model Networks, click the Create New Network button and select “Upload Provider File”. 
* The Upload Provider File page will appear.  Then, either drag and drop a .csv or .xlsx file or select a file by clicking the “Choose File” button.  The imported file must minimally include columns labeled “NPI” and “Zip”.  
* All provider locations that match the submitted NPI within the submitted zip code will be included in the new network.  Columns with different labels and additional columns will not be recognized for mapping but will remain as part of the file. 
* In the Network Name field, enter a name for the new network.  The field’s default is the file name.
* To finish the upload process, click the Upload button.  Once the file is uploaded, it will appear on the Manage Models page labeled with the name the user selected.  To view, edit, or publish the model click on the model’s name to navigate to the model’s page.  Once the model is published it can be used in other Network360 features such as Adequacy, Compare Networks, and Competitive Dashboard. 
* To view the results of the import process, click on the History tab. Use the Outcome Report link to download the report.  The Outcome report includes the matching and validation information based on the uploaded file.  In the Outcome report, first two columns are labeled as “row_action” and “error” so the user can understand which rows were matched and why any were not matched. 

###### *Reference Network, Cost Attributes, & Quality Attributes*

* Another change within Model Networks is the new ability to set the model’s reference network, cost attributes, and quality attributes on the Model Network Summary > Overview tab.  (Previously this functionality was located within the Model Network setup process.)  
* By clicking on the “Add Cost Attributes” and “Add Quality Attributes”, you can select your desired attributes to evaluate your network based on cost and quality scores.   These attributes can provide helpful information for understanding the composition of your model and impacts of any changes you make to your model’s contents.  

  * To set or change the cost or quality target, click the Set Target button and then user the mouse to the desired target within the graph.  The target is represented by a vertical dashed line. 
* When you want to compare your new network’s cost and quality scores to another network, select your desired network in the Reference Network field.  This will enable you to view the reference network’s cost and quality scores within the graphs.  Note: the selection of a reference network is no longer required.  

###  Adequacy

Now, users with the Network Modeler role can access the import network functionality via the Adequacy Feature by clicking on the “Add New Model Network” button.  The process to create a model by uploading a file is the same as described in the Model Networks section of these notes. 

### Create a List

Now, the UI results include a NPI column displaying the provider’s NPI.  If the filed is blank, this means that the project data does not include an NPI for that provider. 

### Concise Office Export

Now, the Concise Office Export lists all offices that are associated with providers that match the search criteria.  In the past, the export contained only the list of offices that matches the list of “best” office that displayed in the UI. 

# Fixes

### Adequacy

Now, the email notification for the HSD .csv exports correctly displays their names as “County Details CSV Export” and “Provider HSD CSV Export.”

### Competitive Dashboard

Now when the user chooses to view results for confirmed providers, the Market Penetration graph and tooltip correctly display the results for confirmed providers (instead of displaying the directory provider results).  



### New User 

Now a new user’s account activation link works correctly and does not display an error message. 



### User Profile

Now, the user’s “Print Name on PDF” selection is retained after the Update Profile button is clicked.
